card.title: Playstation 3 Slim Blue Screen Of Death

source.title: Playstation 3 Slim Blue Screen Of Death

claims.statement: PS3 Slim showing 'Settings information is corrupted' a few seconds after boot is usually a LAN-section fault: damaged LAN port, Marvell LAN controller (88E1118R-NNC2) or a short in that circuit; shorts on several lines around the Marvell IC usually mean the chip is dead.
Match the replacement controller's markings; donors may be needed. A damaged LAN port can even be removed if unused.

procedure: Check for shorts around the LAN controller behind the port.
Inject to find shorts; replace controller (same marking) or port.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
